  |[ ... ]

 is.  I'm getting the VERY vague impression the problem is

 so you want to reduce the amount you(? someone?) must wade

 (and I assume there are other) e-maildrops don't have this
 problem?  (I can think of several reasons, but would prefer
 a clearer explanation of the problem rather than guessing.)
